subject: Orchestrated reserve plan & closure checklist for Horizon Health MAP
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@horizonhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot & MAP — high level ask

Thanks Rishi — following our call, procurement and engineering want a concise MAP that ties evaluation gates to procurement milestones.

Top-level constraints:
- Target production Q3 (mid-July) for initial patient-facing feature.
- Model: ~30B parameter family, 16k context preferred.
- Expected concurrency: 250 concurrent inference sessions at peak; average request length ~600 tokens.
- Compliance: must demonstrate SOC2 evidence and private VPC option for PHI in test environment.

Can you provide a timeline and an explicit GPU reserve ask (tranche sizing + lead times) we can include in the internal procurement request?

Samira
Director, AI Product — Horizon Health

Attachment: Horizon_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot & MAP — high level ask

Samira — thanks for the clear constraints. Draft MAP and capacity ask below (high level) — attaching a sizing model and a first-pass MAP workbook.

Summary (proposed):
1) Evaluation phase (4 weeks): benchmark on a realistic prompt set — 8 GPU staging cluster (A100-40GB equiv) + Redwood hosted endpoints for parallel comparison. Acceptance: latency P50 < 120ms, P95 < 400ms for 4k context; model quality regression < 2% vs baseline metric.

2) Pilot (6 weeks): private VPC staging with truncated production traffic; reserved tranche 40 GPUs (A100/80GB equiv) to support concurrency ~60 qps and warm KV cache. Procurement can sign a 3-month reserved tranche to secure delivery.

3) Production tranche (ramp weeks 12–20): full reserve of 160 GPUs (A100/80GB equiv) phased in three tranches (40 / 60 / 60) aligned with acceptance gates. Full production capacity expected by week 20.

Lead-time notes (typical):
- Dedicated (hosted reserved capacity): 6–10 weeks to guarantee pool placement depending on region and current utilization.
- Private (VPC + customer-managed private endpoints or on-prem): 10–16 weeks due to networking, KMS/HSM integration, and SOC2 evidence handoff.
- On-prem installation (if chosen): 14–20 weeks including procurement and site validation.

Sizing rationale: 30B model + 16k context + 250 concurrent sessions -> estimated sustained token/sec and memory footprints. We recommend an initial committed pool of 40 GPUs to avoid cold-start risk during pilot, then scale to 160 for steady state. See attached capacity_sizing_model.csv for calc.

Requested next steps:
- Procurement confirms a preferred commitment window (3/6/12 months) — we can price and lock tranche delivery.
- Product/Eng to approve evaluation prompt set (we can use the dataset you shared).
- Legal to initiate limited SOW for SOC2 evidence handoff.

I'll loop Marissa for pricing / contractual cadence and Priyom for onboarding sequence.

— Rishi
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: capacity_sizing_model.csv (CSV stub)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@horizonhealth.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot & MAP — high level ask

Quick ops breakdown and risks from Neha (infra lead):

Operational checklist (we'll run these in parallel where possible):
- SOC2 evidence handoff (2 weeks for initial artifacts; full package dependent on vendor timelines).
- VPC peering + routing (est. 1–2 weeks for initial peering; full hardened network 3–5 weeks).
- KMS integration (depends on customer; 1–3 weeks).
- Staging onboarding (data subset, SANDBOX PHI obfuscation): 1 week.

Known risks that affect lead time:
- If on-prem hardware GFX procurement is required, add 4–8 weeks beyond standard Private timeline.
- Long procurement approval cycles at customer side frequently add 2–4 weeks to the earliest commit date.

Recommendation: lock a 3-month reserved tranche for pilot to ensure delivery within the 6–10 week Dedicated window. If procurement prefers Private, schedule their network and KMS kickoff immediately to avoid slipping the Q3 target.

-Neha
Director, Platform Ops — Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 09:33:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Milestones & acceptance criteria (action items)

Samira — converting the MAP into specific acceptance gates for procurement and eng. Please confirm these and sign off on the mutual timeline.

MAP milestones (dates are relative, measured from MAP kick):
- Week 0: MAP signed; procurement issues PO for pilot tranche (40 GPUs).
- Week 1–4: Evaluation — full benchmark, security checklist, prompt-quality evals. Deliverable: evaluation report + go/no-go decision.
- Week 5–10: Pilot — private VPC staging with reserved 40 GPU tranche. Deliverable: pilot acceptance signoff and SOC2 artifact snapshot.
- Week 11–20: Production ramp — tranche 2/3 delivered and capacity scaled to 160 GPUs. Deliverable: production readiness and SLA handover.

Acceptance criteria (short):
- Latency and throughput meet agreed SLOs (P50/P95 numbers).
- Quality: annotation-based comparison against baseline — pass threshold >= 95%.
- Security: signed acceptance of SOC2 evidence + successful VPC connectivity tests.

Action items:
- Horizon: confirm PO window and preferred commit term (3/6/12 months).
- Horizon: nominate procurement contact to execute PO and handle GL/accounting codes.
- Redwood: provide final pricing worksheet and SOW draft by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks — Priyom
Director, Customer Onboarding — Redwood Inference

From: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@horizonhealth.com>

All — procurement confirmed they can cut a PO for a 3-month pilot tranche (40 GPUs) if we provide a clear delivery SLA and acceptance checklist. They also asked for a short note on cost delta between Dedicated reserved capacity vs Private hosted VPC for the pilot tranche.

Next: Marissa, can you send the two-line pricing delta and the SOW stub? We need the doc to move this internally today.

— Luis
Head of Procurement — Horizon Health
